subject: Coord: Redwood x CloudScale co-sell demo — ops window & timezone buffer
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean@cloudscale.com>, Anika Rao <anika.rao@nebula-systems.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Coord: Redwood x CloudScale co-sell demo — ops window & timezone buffer

Hi Sean / Anika —

Thanks again for coordinating on the joint demo for Nebula Systems. We typically run a 75–90 minute co-sell session (30–40 min product + 30 min SI technical + 15–20 min Q&A / procurement next steps). To keep things smooth across timezones, could you confirm whether the customer prefers: 

- Option A: 2027-07-01 10:00–11:30 PT (13:00–14:30 ET) — US-friendly window
- Option B: 2027-07-02 15:00–16:30 BST (07:00–08:30 PT) — better for APAC overlap

A couple of asks from our side: 
- We’d like a 30-min dry-run with the SI and Redwood techs 48 hours before the slot (run-through and marketplace consent checklist).
- Please confirm whether the SI will present the initial 20–30 min technical deep-dive or if you prefer Redwood to lead the product demo first.
- Marketplace consent/permissions for co-sell may require the customer to accept a console consent; allow a 72-hour lead time if that’s required.

I’ve attached a short draft runbook and a one-pager to help scope the session (runbook-draft.pdf, redwood-product-one-pager.pdf). If you prefer, here’s a quick Calendly link to lock a slot: https://calendly.com/redwood/demo-789

Looping in Karthik (co-sell lead), Vanessa (marketplace), and Marissa (solutions engineer) to coordinate logistics and the dry-run.

Thanks — look forward to confirming.

— Priyom
Priyom Das | Partnerships, Redwood Inference
priym.das@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0184

From: Sean Gallagher <sean@cloudscale.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Anika Rao <anika.rao@nebula-systems.com>
Cc: Langley Field <langley@enterpriseops.com>
Date: 2027-06-21T17:05:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Coord: Redwood x CloudScale co-sell demo — ops window & timezone buffer

Hi Priyom —

Thanks for the options. Nebula’s procurement team flagged a conflict on 07/01 morning ET; they’re available on 07/01 but only after 16:00 ET. Would any of these work for you and the internal team?

- Alternative 1: 2027-07-01 16:30–18:00 ET (13:30–15:00 PT)
- Alternative 2: 2027-07-05 09:00–10:30 PT (12:00–13:30 ET)

We also want to confirm the dry-run: 48 hours prior would put it on 06/29 for the first proposed date — is that feasible? The customer asks that we include a short agenda item for SSO + marketplace consent steps (they’ve had issues in the past).

For context: I’ll be presenting the SI technical portion with Anika from Nebula on the customer side; we’ll need Marissa to validate the GCP region routing (Nebula is hosting a PoC in europe-west1).

If you want, I can hold the tentative slot in our calendar for 07/01 16:30 ET and we can confirm once Redwood signs off.

Cheers,
Sean Gallagher
Director, Partnerships | CloudScale Solutions
sean@cloudscale.com | +1 617-555-0122

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-22T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Coord: Redwood x CloudScale co-sell demo — ops window & timezone buffer

Priyom — copying in Vanessa and Marissa to coordinate. Quick notes from the Redwood side: 

- Marketplace consent: Vanessa, can you confirm whether the CloudScale/Nebula combo needs any prior marketplace provisioning? If so we’ll give them a 72-hour heads-up — I suspect they do for GCP marketplace.
- Dry-run timing: 48 hours is fine but let’s make it 45–60 minutes and restrict it to tech owners only (Marissa + Sean + Anika + Redwood infra eng). We don’t need execs on the dry-run.
- Proposed session length: I recommend trimming the initial public-facing demo to 35 minutes and keeping a 45-minute SI deep-dive to allow for troubleshooting with Nebula’s PoC. We can end with a 10–15 min procurement/next-steps block.

I’ve added the HubSpot deal id HS-98764 to the calendar note so GTM has visibility. Also: note for scheduling — if we accept 07/01 16:30 ET, that’s 13:30 PT which still works for our west coast folks. If Nebula requires marketplace consent, mark the calendar as tentative until the consent is completed.

Vanessa — could you start the marketplace permission check and confirm requirements (consent flow, required contact email) and post back here?

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-06-22T12:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Coord: Redwood x CloudScale co-sell demo — ops window & timezone buffer

Thanks all — finalizing.

We’ll lock 2027-07-01 13:30–15:00 PT (16:30–18:00 ET) for the joint demo. Action items: 

- Sean / Anika: please confirm customer acceptance of 07/01 16:30 ET by EOD today and share any required attendee list (SSO admins for consent).
- Vanessa: please run the marketplace consent check and share the consent link or required contact (we need confirmation within 72 hours).
- Marissa / Karthik: schedule a 45–60 minute dry-run on 2027-06-29 at 10:00 PT. If that conflicts, propose an alternate 06/29 slot.
- I’ve attached the runbook-draft.pdf and the one-pager again and added a shared Drive link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2B3Crunbook
- Tentative HubSpot deal: HS-98764 (I’ve set the event as tentative until marketplace consent is confirmed).

Calendly/Invite to confirm: https://calendly.com/redwood/demo-789 — once Sean confirms, I’ll send the Google Calendar invite and a formal agenda.
